items.Sentence: Primary sewage treatment is provided by an 80,000-gallon three-chambered cast-in-place septic tank.

After flow measurement, septic tank effluent is conveyed to a 40,000-gallon recirculation tank. The recirculation tank provides additional storage ... and an anoxic environment for continued denitrification.
The effluent goes to two recirculating gravel filters ... The filters provide an aerobic environment which promotes nitrification as well as further BOD and TSS removal.
The recirculating gravel filters are dosed with wastewater from the recirculation tank using two recirculation pumps (one on duty and one on standby).
The wet well is equipped with two pumps (one in use and one on standby). Effluent pumped to the leach field will not be disinfected.
The solids in the septic tank will be periodically pumped and hauled to an appropriate offsite location for treatment and disposal.
